propositions: Agent with Serena configured continues using grep for symbol lookup despite documented preference for Serena's LSP tools, because launch-time guidance in AGENTS.md loses salience mid-task.
A PreToolUse hook on Bash tool must emit a non-blocking reminder when grep/rg/egrep/fgrep is invoked, surfacing it to the model via JSON hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext.
The reminder trigger is a plain string match for grep-family commands with no pattern classification or path heuristics, deliberately accepting false positives to avoid fragile predicates.
The reminder message must be ≤3 lines, name both find_referencing_symbols as preferred AND the legitimate grep use cases (string literals, line numbers), so it never misleads the agent.
The hook must never block execution, exit non-zero, or emit permissionDecision, remaining purely informative.
Story C (.claude/settings.json tracking) must be completed first and its env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH setting preserved when this hook is merged into the config.
